description: This Python test file uses pytest to test a FastAPI application, focusing on API endpoints for retrieving item data and the OpenAPI schema. It dynamically imports modules based on different Pythons versions and verifies responses and schema correctness.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the test parameter, creates and returns a TestClient instance for the FastAPI app in that module.

methods.name: test_get_car(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that checks the GET request to '/items/item1' returns a successful response with expected JSON data for a car.

methods.name: test_get_plane(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that checks the GET request to '/items/item2' returns a successful response with expected JSON data for a plane.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that verifies the OpenAPI JSON schema returned by the FastAPI application matches the expected schema snapshot.
